title: Integer Magnitude Estimator
brief: A microcontroller without a floating point unit computes signal energy readings as integers, and the display shows the magnitude as the whole-number root of the energy. We need that value using integer arithmetic only.
Implement integerRootFloor(x), where x is the energy reading, and return the largest non-negative integer whose square is at most x.
